guard.auditLogPath.label: Audit Log Path
guard.auditLogPath.help: JSONL path to append Layer 1 guard trip records to (term id, surface, action taken — never the matched text).

reflex.logPath.label: Reflex Log Path
reflex.logPath.help: JSONL path to append Layer 2 reflex-log records to (warranted turns only).

guard.description: Layer 1 — deterministic outbound sealed-term guard. No LLM call.

terms.description: Sealed-term list. NEVER commit real sealed/sensitive terms to this repo — inject the real list via gateway config on the operator's machine only. Ships empty by default.

id.description: Stable term id. Used in audit-log records and nowhere else — never the sealed phrase itself.

pattern.description: Literal substring (case-insensitive) or regex source, depending on `type`.

flags.description: Regex flags, only used when type is "regex". Defaults to "i".

action.description: "block" cancels delivery; "flag" only audit-logs the trip and lets the message through.

description.description: Human-readable operator note. NEVER the sealed phrase itself.

auditLogPath.description: JSONL path for guard trip records (term id, surface, action taken).

reflex.description: Layer 2 — fuzzy reflex scaffold on before_agent_finalize. Off by default.

enabled.description: Explicit opt-in. Defaults to false — ships as a scaffold, not a live guard.

logPath.description: JSONL path for reflex-log records (warranted turns only).
